title: Dometic 12 oz Tumbler, Frost

comparisons.notes: Exact match Dometic Tumbler 350 (12 oz) in Frost, MPN 97000071426, with Swig Lid; in stock as a special-order item with a 3-5 week lead time

writeup: Woot has the Dometic 12 oz Tumbler in Frost, new, for $14.99. Nomadic Supply sells the exact same Frost tumbler (MPN 97000071426) for $24.99, and Dometic's own site lists it at the same price, so this is 40% less. It's a copper-lined, double-wall vacuum steel tumbler with a magnetic flip Swig Lid. Only one was left when we checked, with a limit of three per customer.
